claims: Girona is a Catalan city in northeastern Spain.
Girona has a medieval Old Town called Barri Vell.
Girona has colorful houses along the Onyar River.
Girona has 1st-century BC Roman walls.
Girona is known as the "City of the Four Rivers".
Girona is a day trip from Barcelona.
Girona Cathedral features the world's widest Gothic nave.
Girona Cathedral requires a climb up steps.
Passeig de la Muralla is a walk on extensive restored medieval city walls.
Passeig de la Muralla provides panoramic views of the city and Pyrenees.
El Call is Girona's Jewish Quarter.
El Call is one of the best-preserved Jewish quarters in Europe.
Onyar River Houses are brightly painted houses overlooking the Onyar River.
Banys Àrabs are Romanesque-style baths dating back to the 12th century.
Plaça de la Independència is a neoclassical square.
Girona was founded by Romans.
Girona has seen Roman rule.
Girona has seen Moorish rule.
Girona has seen Frankish rule.
Visitors touch or kiss the butt of the "Lioness of Girona" (Leona de Girona) as a tradition.
Girona is known for the pastry xuixo.
Figueres is home to the Teatre-Museu Gala-Salvador Dalí.
Girona is in Catalonia, Spain.
Girona is near the French border.
Girona is 40 minutes from Barcelona by high-speed train.
Girona city has a population of around 100,000+.
Girona province has a population of over 700,000.
